rev.t: It is one of very oldest book stall, during our college days we used to purchase books from this place. It was so popular that if you don't get any books in any other stores , you can visit this shop.

Awesome book store in bangalore with some discounts.. The one of the top book store in bangalore.. Huge collection of books available here.. Very polite people are working here.. Especially the Thatha who sit on the cashier counter... It’s too good than Sapna book house... I love this store..
